{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Climbing and Ropework class''' was a class taught by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bear (Jedi)|Bear]]. One subject taught in the class was how to create the [[Twelve Intermediate Knots]].<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="YDRDate">According to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the events of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' occur in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. As [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Enwandung-Esterhazy]] having assisted [[Pax Chizzik|Chizzik]] in practicing the knots is described as having occurred prior to the events of the novel, it can be assumed that this occurred by 19 BBY.</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] had assisted [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Pax Chizzik]] in practicing the Twelve Intermediate Knots in this class.<ref name="YDR" />

{{Edu-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Climbing and Ropework class was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', written by [[Sean Stewart]]<ref name="YDR" /> and released on [[November 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/173523/yoda-dark-rendezvous-star-wars-legends-by-sean-stewart/9780345463098|text=Yoda: Dark Rendezvous: Star Wars Legends}} {{C|Paperback}}</ref>
